versions.changelog:
Initial release of geo-content-publisher: a workflow orchestrator for end-to-end publishing and distribution of GEO-optimized content.

- Automates the full GEO content lifecycle: optimization, cross-channel distribution, and AI/SEO signaling.
- Coordinates with other GEO skills (optimizers, schema generators, etc.) for specialized tasks.
- Provides clear workflows for turning core content into channel-specific variants (blog, social, docs, newsletter).
- Ensures content is published in AI- and crawler-friendly formats (sitemaps, schemas, structured data).
- Outputs detailed publishing briefs, readiness checks, and channel mapping to streamline multi-platform launches.
